mails.subject: Re: Question about desks and a trial day
mails.body:
Hi Mette,

Thanks for the quick answer. You wrote: "We have two fixed desks open from November."

That sounds great. Could I come for a trial day next Thursday, 24 September? I am a freelance illustrator and work alone, so one desk is all I need.
Also, what is the monthly price for a fixed desk, and is there a deposit?
I will bring my own laptop and headphones.

Best,
Tobias Lindqvist
mails.justification: A prospective member asks about prices, desk availability and a trial day in an ongoing thread, which is a membership request needing a personal reply within the week.

mails.subject: Mise en pause de mon abonnement
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Je suis membre du Hangar Nord depuis mars avec un bureau fixe. Je pars en congé de longue durée du 1er novembre au 31 janvier.
Est-il possible de mettre mon abonnement en pause pendant cette période, ou dois-je le résilier et le reprendre en février ?
Mon préavis serait-il de un mois dans les deux cas ?
Merci d'avance pour votre retour.

Camille Roussel
mails.justification: A member asks how to pause or end their membership with no urgent date, so it is a membership question needing a human reply within the week.

mails.subject: Workshop proposal for November
mails.body:
Hello, we are Nordlys Makers, a small design collective. We would like to host a free evening workshop on risograph printing in your space in November, about 25 people.
We can pay a room fee of 1,500 DKK. Could you tell us which Thursdays are free?
mails.justification: An outside organiser proposes hosting a workshop next month and offers a fee, an event proposal needing a reply within the week.

mails.subject: Salle pour mardi soir
mails.body:
Bonsoir, désolée d'écrire si tard. Pour notre soirée de mardi à 19h, pourrait-on avoir le grand projecteur, 30 chaises et la salle du fond plutôt que celle du haut ?
Pouvez-vous me confirmer avant lundi midi ? Merci beaucoup, Léa
mails.justification: An organiser sent late on a weekend asks for projector, chairs and a room change for an event in a few days, so event, 24-hour urgency, reply needed.

mails.subject: Moving Wednesday's room + a favour 🙏
mails.body:
Hey team! 👋

Quick one from Priya (Quietpine Labs, desk 12). I booked the Birch room on Wednesday 30 September from 14:00 to 16:00 for a client call, but the client just pushed it to Thursday, same time. Is the Birch room free then? 🤞
If Birch is taken, the Oak room would also work, as long as there is a screen I can plug into.
If neither is free on Thursday, just cancel Wednesday's booking and I will find another slot next week, no problem.

Also, totally unrelated to my booking: my friend Elias is running a small community meetup in the main hall this Friday evening, about 40 people. He asked me to pass on his requests since he is not in the mailing list yet.
He would love the big projector with a microphone, and 40 chairs in rows instead of the cafe tables. 😅
He says he can arrive at 16:00 to set up, if someone can open the hall for him.

Could you reply to both things when you get a minute? Thanks a lot!!

Priya ☀️
mails.justification: A member asks to move a meeting room booking this week, with a passing mention of an event AV and chairs request, so room_booking with 24-hour urgency and a needed reply.

mails.subject: Forespørgsel vedrørende leje af mødelokale
mails.body:
Til rette vedkommende,

Jeg skriver på vegne af Københavns Kursuscenter, en uddannelsesinstitution med kurser for voksne. Vi overvejer at leje et lokale hos jer til en hel dag i løbet af efteråret.
Der vil være omkring 14 deltagere, og vi har brug for et lokale med projektor og mulighed for kaffe og frokost.
Vi har endnu ikke fastlagt en dato, da det afhænger af, hvornår underviseren er tilgængelig.
Kunne I venligst oplyse, om jeres lokaler kan lejes for en hel dag af eksterne, og hvad prisen er for en dag?
Hører vi gerne, hvilke dage der typisk er ledige, og om der er særlige vilkår for faste kunder.
Vi har brug for oplysningerne til vores interne budgetgodkendelse, men der er ingen hast.
Hvis det er nødvendigt, kan vi aftale et kort besøg i lokalerne, så vi kan se dem før beslutningen.
Vi modtager også gerne jeres standardvilkår for leje og eventuelle afbestillingsregler.

Med venlig hilsen

Mette Skovgaard
Kursuskoordinator
Københavns Kursuscenter
Tlf. 55 01 02 03
mails.justification: An institution asks whether a room can be rented for a day with no date set, a room_booking inquiry with no deadline needing a reply within the week.

mails.subject: Heating broken in the quiet room
mails.body:
Hi,

The quiet room on the 2nd floor has been freezing since monday, i think the radiator is not workin at all. I checked with two other people and its the same for them.
Its getting really hard to work there, my hands are cold in the mornings. Also the wifi in that room keeps droping.
Could someone come look at it before the weekend please? Thanks.

Daniel Okafor
Sent from my iPhone
mails.justification: A member reports broken heating and wifi and asks for a fix this week, a complaint needing a reply within 24 hours.

mails.subject: Re: Locked out - card not working
mails.body:
Hi again,

Thanks for replying so fast. You said: "Please try the card on the side door instead."

I tried that too and nothing happens, the light stays red. I have been standing outside for 20 minutes and I have a client presentation at 9:00 that is on my desk inside.
I also noticed the side door does not fully latch, so anyone could walk in tonight. That is probably a security problem you should know about.
My card number is 0482. It worked yesterday evening when I left at 18:30.
Can someone come down and let me in right now, or tell me the code for the door? My phone number is 20 55 01 99.

Another thing, since I am writing: a colleague of mine, Jakob, is interested in joining. Could he do a trial day next week and what are the prices for a flexible desk?
He would only need it two or three days a week.
No rush on that one, the door is the priority.

Ingrid
mails.justification: A member is locked out with a failing access card and a door security problem right now, so complaint with highest urgency, with a passing membership question about a trial day.

mails.subject: Invoice 2026-0317 and VAT number
mails.body:
Hello,

We are a member company with two desks. The invoice 2026-0317 for October was issued without our VAT number.
Our accountant needs it on the invoice for the quarterly return. The VAT number is DK 00 00 00 00.
Could you issue a corrected invoice for the amount of 4,800 DKK and send it to this address?
We also had one card payment fail on 1 October, so please tell us if it was retried.
Thank you.

Henrik Bauer
mails.justification: A member asks for a corrected invoice with a VAT number and checks a failed card payment, a billing request needing a reply within 24 hours.
